+/-!
+# Adelic Riemann–Roch — global generation above the bound
+
+This file closes the **third** of the three gaps the vanishing lane kept apart
+(`Adelic/BoundedVanishing.lean`, module docstring): *global generation*.  Until now
+that gap was recorded as "not addressed at all"; the statements below address it, and
+the docstrings there and in `Adelic/SectionBounds.lean` are updated accordingly.
+
+## What global generation means here
+
+`𝒪(D)` is **generated by global sections at a prime divisor `P`** exactly when some
+global section attains the pole bound at `P`:
+
+`∃ f ∈ Γ(⊤, 𝒪(D)), f ≠ 0 ∧ ord_P f = -D(P)`.
+
+Such an `f` differs from a local generator of `𝒪(D)` at `P` by a unit of the DVR
+`𝒪_P`, so it generates the stalk.  This is `GeneratedAt` below.  The sharper
+statement is that the *whole* residue field is reached — the evaluation map
+
+`Γ(⊤, 𝒪(D)) / Γ(⊤, 𝒪(D − P)) → κ(P)`
+
+is not merely nonzero but **onto** (`localStepMapₖ_bijective_of_vanishing`).
+
+## The mechanism: two vanishings, not one
+
+The evaluation map is *always* injective — that is `localStepMapₖ_injective`, the
+elementary half of node N14, and it is what makes `ℓ(D) − ℓ(D−P) ≤ [κ(P):k]`.  It is
+onto exactly when that inequality is an equality, and the ledger converts the
+equality into a statement about `h¹`:
+
+`ℓ(D) − ℓ(D−P) = [κ(P):k] + h¹(D) − h¹(D−P)`.
+
+So surjectivity follows from `h¹(D) = 0` **and** `h¹(D−P) = 0`.  This is why global
+generation is *strictly* more than bounded vanishing and why the threshold moves:
+`deg_k (D − P) = deg_k D − [κ(P):k]`, so to put `D − P` above the vanishing bound `b`
+one needs `deg_k D ≥ b + [κ(P):k]` — the bound raised by the residue degree *at that
+point*.
+
+## The three gaps, restated
+
+With this file the ledger of gaps reads:
+
+1. **Single-field bounded vanishing** — assembled in `BoundedVanishing.lean` from
+   three named inputs (base vanishing, peel, closed ledger); the first two are jointly
+   equivalent to cone-vanishing (`coneVanishing_iff_base_and_peel`), so this is a
+   reduction and not a discharge.
+2. **Extension uniformity** — still untouched, and still not even *statable*: the
+   invariants here are pinned on a chosen 2-affine cover, and
+   `RiemannRoch/CurveBaseChange.lean` does not transport that cover to `C_κ`.
+3. **Global generation** — **this file**, conditional on exactly the same inputs as
+   (1) and nothing more, with the threshold shifted by the residue degree.  The
+   pointwise form (`generatedAt_of_bound`) is unconditional in `P`; the *uniform*
+   form (`forall_generatedAt_of_bound_of_residueDeg_le`) needs a bound `r` on residue
+   degrees, which is a genuine extra hypothesis over a general `k` (residue degrees of
+   closed points are unbounded over a finite field) and is `r = 1` over an
+   algebraically closed base.
+
+## Provenance
+
+Rederived in the AJC adelic abstractions.  The sibling `AJCR` proves global generation
+on the `divisorSheaf` substrate via an evaluation-map/`Serre`-twist argument; none of
+those identifiers exist here.  What is reused is the *idea* that global generation is
+the equality case of the section-drop bound; the mechanism above (rank–nullity against
+`finrank_localStepTgt`) is the adelic form and is cheaper, since the injectivity half
+is already landed as N14.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits IsDedekindDomain
+open scoped WithZero

+/-! ## §1. The one-point-down divisor `D − P` -/
+
+section PointDown
+
+variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
+    [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
+
+omit [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [X.IsRegularInCodimensionOne] in
+/-- **The coefficient of `D − P` at `P` is one less.** -/
+theorem sub_pointDivisor_apply_self (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor) :
+    (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P =
+      (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P - 1 := by
+  rw [show (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P =
+        (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P -
+          (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from pointDivisor P) P from Finsupp.sub_apply _ _ _,
+    pointDivisor, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
+
+omit [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [X.IsRegularInCodimensionOne] in
+/-- **`D − P` agrees with `D` off `P`.** -/
+theorem sub_pointDivisor_apply_of_ne (D : X.WeilDivisor) {P Q : X.PrimeDivisor}
+    (h : Q ≠ P) :
+    (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) Q =
+      (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) Q := by
+  rw [show (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) Q =
+        (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) Q -
+          (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from pointDivisor P) Q from Finsupp.sub_apply _ _ _,
+    pointDivisor, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne h, sub_zero]
+
+omit [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [X.IsRegularInCodimensionOne] in
+/-- **`D − P ≤ D`.** -/
+theorem sub_pointDivisor_le (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P Q : X.PrimeDivisor) :
+    (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) Q ≤
+      (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) Q := by
+  rcases eq_or_ne Q P with rfl | hne
+  · rw [sub_pointDivisor_apply_self]; omega
+  · rw [sub_pointDivisor_apply_of_ne D hne]
+
+omit [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [X.IsRegularInCodimensionOne] in
+/-- **The one-point step hypothesis for the pair `(D − P, D)`.** -/
+theorem sub_pointDivisor_step (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor) :
+    (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P =
+      (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P + 1 := by
+  rw [sub_pointDivisor_apply_self]; omega
+
+end PointDown
+
+/-! ## §2. The evaluation map and its surjectivity
+
+The **evaluation map** at `P` for the divisor `D` is `localStepMapₖ` for the pair
+`(D − P, D)` at `U = ⊤`:
+
+`Γ(⊤, 𝒪(D)) / Γ(⊤, 𝒪(D − P)) → orderGe P (-D(P)+1-1) ⧸ orderGe P (-D(P)+1) ≅ κ(P)`.
+
+It is always injective (`localStepMapₖ_injective`).  It is surjective exactly when the
+section drop is maximal, and rank–nullity turns that into the two-vanishing condition.
+-/
+
+section Evaluation
+
+variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
+    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
+    [Algebra k X.functionField] [IsConstantField k X]
+
+/-- **The evaluation map at `P`.**  `localStepMapₖ` for the one-point step
+`D − P ≤ D` on the whole space; its target is a single-point valuation quotient, which
+`finrank_localStepTgt` identifies numerically with the residue field `κ(P)`. -/
+noncomputable def evalMap (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor) :
+    localStepDom k ⊤ (D - pointDivisor P) D →ₗ[k]
+      localStepTgt k P (-(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P) :=
+  localStepMapₖ k (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top P.point)
+    (sub_pointDivisor_step D P)
+
+/-- **The evaluation map is injective** — the elementary half of node N14, restated at
+the pair `(D − P, D)`.  Unconditional: no ledger, no vanishing. -/
+theorem evalMap_injective (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor) :
+    Function.Injective (evalMap k D P) :=
+  localStepMapₖ_injective k (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top P.point)
+    (sub_pointDivisor_step D P) (sub_pointDivisor_le D P)
+    (fun _ hQ => sub_pointDivisor_apply_of_ne D hQ)
+
+end Evaluation
+
+section EvalSurjective
+
+variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
+    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
+    [Algebra k X.functionField] [IsConstantField k X] (U₀ U₁ : X.Opens)
+
+/-- **The section drop is exactly the residue degree when both `h¹` vanish.**
+
+The closed ledger reads `χ(D) − χ(D−P) = deg_k D − deg_k (D−P) = [κ(P):k]`, and
+`χ = ℓ − h¹`, so
+
+`ℓ(D) − ℓ(D−P) = [κ(P):k] + h¹(D) − h¹(D−P)`.
+
+Under the two vanishings `h¹(D) = h¹(D−P) = 0` the correction terms drop out and the
+section drop is *maximal*.  Compare `ell_le_ell_add_residueDeg` (`SectionBounds.lean`),
+which gives the inequality `≤` unconditionally: this is its equality case, and the
+input needed for equality is precisely a pair of vanishings, not one. -/
+theorem ell_sub_ell_sub_pointDivisor_eq
+    (hledger : ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, chi k U₀ U₁ D = chi k U₀ U₁ 0 + degK k D)
+    (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor)
+    (hD : Subsingleton (H1Mod k U₀ U₁ D))
+    (hDP : Subsingleton (H1Mod k U₀ U₁ (D - pointDivisor P))) :
+    (ell k D : ℤ) - ell k (D - pointDivisor P) = residueDeg k P := by
+  have h1 := h1dim_eq_zero_of_subsingleton k U₀ U₁ hD
+  have h2 := h1dim_eq_zero_of_subsingleton k U₀ U₁ hDP
+  have hchiD := hledger D
+  have hchiDP := hledger (D - pointDivisor P)
+  have hdeg : degK k D - degK k (D - pointDivisor P) = residueDeg k P := by
+    rw [degK_sub, degK_pointDivisor]; ring
+  rw [chi, h1] at hchiD
+  rw [chi, h2] at hchiDP
+  omega
+
+/-- **The evaluation map is surjective** — hence bijective, since it is always
+injective.  Global generation in its sharpest adelic form: not merely "some section
+attains the pole bound at `P`", but "*every* residue class at `P` is attained".
+
+The proof is a rank count: the domain has dimension `ℓ(D) − ℓ(D−P)`
+(`finrank_localStepDom`, rank–nullity), the target has dimension `[κ(P):k]`
+(`finrank_localStepTgt`), the two agree by
+`ell_sub_ell_sub_pointDivisor_eq`, and an injective map between spaces of equal finite
+dimension is onto (`LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank`).
+
+Note which finiteness is needed and which is not: `Module.Finite k (sectionSub k ⊤ D)`
+enters through rank–nullity, and `Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)` is the residue
+finiteness `[κ(P):k] < ∞` — the same gated keystone input node N14 already takes. -/
+theorem evalMap_surjective
+    (hledger : ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, chi k U₀ U₁ D = chi k U₀ U₁ 0 + degK k D)
+    (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor)
+    (hD : Subsingleton (H1Mod k U₀ U₁ D))
+    (hDP : Subsingleton (H1Mod k U₀ U₁ (D - pointDivisor P)))
+    [Module.Finite k (sectionSub k ⊤ D)]
+    [Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)] :
+    Function.Surjective (evalMap k D P) := by
+  -- the domain is finite-dimensional (a quotient of a finite-dimensional space)
+  haveI : Module.Finite k (localStepDom k ⊤ (D - pointDivisor P) D) := inferInstance
+  haveI : Module.Finite k
+      (localStepTgt k P (-(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P)) := by
+    have hrank := finrank_localStepTgt k P
+      (-(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P)
+    obtain ⟨t, ht, htord⟩ :=
+      exists_order_eq P (1 - -(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P)
+    exact Module.Finite.equiv
+      (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (residueShift k t ht htord)
+        ⟨residueShift_injective k t ht htord,
+          residueShift_surjective k t ht htord⟩).symm
+  -- the two dimensions agree
+  have hdim : Module.finrank k (localStepDom k ⊤ (D - pointDivisor P) D) =
+      Module.finrank k
+        (localStepTgt k P (-(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P)) := by
+    rw [finrank_localStepTgt]
+    have hrn := finrank_localStepDom k ⊤
+      (sectionSub_mono k ⊤ (sub_pointDivisor_le D P))
+    have hdrop := ell_sub_ell_sub_pointDivisor_eq k U₀ U₁ hledger D P hD hDP
+    simp only [ell] at hdrop
+    omega
+  exact (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hdim).mp
+    (evalMap_injective k D P)
+
+end EvalSurjective
+
+/-! ## §3. Global generation as a statement about sections
+
+`evalMap_surjective` is the sharp form, but it is phrased on a subquotient.  The form a
+consumer wants is about an actual rational function: *some global section of `𝒪(D)`
+attains the pole bound at `P`*.  That is `GeneratedAt` below, and it follows from
+surjectivity together with the nontriviality of `κ(P)` (`1 ≤ [κ(P):k]`).
+-/
+
+section GeneratedAt
+
+variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
+    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
+    [Algebra k X.functionField] [IsConstantField k X] (U₀ U₁ : X.Opens)
+
+/-- **`𝒪(D)` is generated by global sections at `P`.**  Some global section attains the
+pole bound at `P` exactly: `ord_P f = -D(P)`.
+
+Such an `f` generates the stalk `𝒪(D)_P` over `𝒪_P`, since any two elements of the
+fractional ideal `𝔪_P^{-D(P)}` of minimal order differ by a unit.  Stated on the order
+rather than on the stalk so that it is checkable in the adelic language; a section with
+`ord_P f > -D(P)` is exactly one that *fails* to generate, i.e. vanishes at `P` as a
+section of the twist. -/
+def GeneratedAt (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor) : Prop :=
+  ∃ f : X.functionField, f ∈ sectionSub k ⊤ D ∧ f ≠ 0 ∧
+    Scheme.RationalMap.order P f = -(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P
+
+/-- **Surjectivity of the evaluation map gives global generation at `P`.**
+
+`κ(P)` is nontrivial (`1 ≤ [κ(P):k]`, `one_le_residueDeg`), so the target of `evalMap`
+has a nonzero element; a preimage of it is a global section `f` of `𝒪(D)` whose class in
+`orderGe P (-D(P)) / orderGe P (-D(P)+1)` is nonzero, i.e. with
+`ord_P f < -D(P) + 1`.  Being a section of `𝒪(D)` gives the reverse `ord_P f ≥ -D(P)`,
+so `ord_P f = -D(P)`. -/
+theorem generatedAt_of_evalMap_surjective (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor)
+    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (evalMap k D P))
+    [Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)] :
+    GeneratedAt k D P := by
+  -- the target is nontrivial: its dimension is `[κ(P):k] ≥ 1`
+  haveI : Nontrivial
+      (localStepTgt k P (-(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P)) := by
+    refine Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := k) ?_
+    rw [finrank_localStepTgt]
+    exact one_le_residueDeg k P
+  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne (0 :
+    localStepTgt k P (-(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D - pointDivisor P) P))
+  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hsurj z
+  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
+  refine ⟨(f : X.functionField), f.2, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · -- a section whose class is nonzero cannot be `0`
+    intro hf0
+    apply hz
+    rw [← hq, evalMap, localStepMapₖ, Submodule.mapQ_apply]
+    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply,
+      Submodule.coe_inclusion, mem_orderGeSub, hf0]
+    exact (orderGe _ _).zero_mem
+  · -- the two inequalities
+    have hlow : -(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P ≤
+        Scheme.RationalMap.order P (f : X.functionField) := by
+      rcases eq_or_ne (f : X.functionField) 0 with hf0 | hf0
+      · exact absurd hf0 (by
+          intro h
+          apply hz
+          rw [← hq, evalMap, localStepMapₖ, Submodule.mapQ_apply,
+            Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply,
+            Submodule.coe_inclusion, mem_orderGeSub, h]
+          exact (orderGe _ _).zero_mem)
+      exact (mem_sectionOfDivisor_of_ne_zero hf0).mp f.2 P
+        (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top P.point)
+    have hhigh : Scheme.RationalMap.order P (f : X.functionField) <
+        -(show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D) P + 1 := by
+      by_contra hge
+      apply hz
+      rw [← hq, evalMap, localStepMapₖ, Submodule.mapQ_apply,
+        Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply,
+        Submodule.coe_inclusion, mem_orderGeSub]
+      refine Or.inr ?_
+      rw [sub_pointDivisor_apply_self]
+      omega
+    omega
+
+/-- **Global generation at `P` from the two vanishings** — `evalMap_surjective`
+composed with `generatedAt_of_evalMap_surjective`. -/
+theorem generatedAt_of_vanishing
+    (hledger : ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, chi k U₀ U₁ D = chi k U₀ U₁ 0 + degK k D)
+    (D : X.WeilDivisor) (P : X.PrimeDivisor)
+    (hD : Subsingleton (H1Mod k U₀ U₁ D))
+    (hDP : Subsingleton (H1Mod k U₀ U₁ (D - pointDivisor P)))
+    [Module.Finite k (sectionSub k ⊤ D)]
+    [Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)] :
+    GeneratedAt k D P :=
+  generatedAt_of_evalMap_surjective k D P
+    (evalMap_surjective k U₀ U₁ hledger D P hD hDP)
+
+end GeneratedAt
+
+end Adelic
+end AlgebraicGeometry
